title: [Request] Visual indication of poison
body: I think the healthbar should turn green or something if you are poisoned. Often I get poisoned and take a bunch of damage from it without knowing, only seeing the message that the poison is gone after the fact.
author: megatog615

comments.body:
The game will now display the HP bar in green when the player is poisoned (whether it be due to an enemy poisoning your or equipped a cursed item that applies poison). 

This feature will be included in the next release.

title: Some tiles not becoming dark
body: Some tiles next to rooms do not go dark when walking away from them.
author: megatog615

comments.body: Easy to reproduce, but this one might take me a bit to figure out since I'm guessing it's related to my tile caching code (which has been a huge pain since I added it).
I think I have this one figured out.  Some more testing, then I'll make sure it gets in the next release.

title: Rooms do not appear as explored on the map
body: Rooms appear completely in the main view but still require complete exploration just like pathways on the map.
author: megatog615

comments.body: I've fixed this and I'll include it as part of the next release.  Should be in a couple days after I've made sure everything works.

title: Cannot pick up items dropped on stairs
body: Items dropped on stairs cannot be picked up, rather the player advances up or down the stairs instead. Items should drop beside the stair tile if possible.
author: megatog615

comments.body:
I'm actually surprised items could be dropped on the stairs at all since I have a specific check for it (so it shouldn't be allowed).  I tried it myself, and while the 'you can't drop it' part works, the item actually disappears permanently from the inventory, which is even worse.

I'll take a look into this (and the other problems you found) in the next few days.

I've added code to fix the case (which I wasn't checking for) when an enemy dies on or around stairs and tries to drop items on them.  Items will now drop adjacent to the stairs.  I also fixed the bug where items the player tries to drop disappear from the inventory.  

These fixes will be part of the next release.
Sorry, I actually meant when a monster death drops something. But it looks like you caught that too.
Just defeated a kobold and it dropped a potion on some stairs. It dropped the item two tiles away onto the stairs.

title: [request] equipped/unidentified colored boxes around items
body: for equipped and unidentified items in the inventory, perhaps a colored square(or concentric squares for equipped unidentified items) around the item's icon could be used to better display things.
author: megatog615

comments.body:
I'd actually spent some time thinking about how to communicate that.  I've added the following:

- Unidentified items have a stippled background
- Identified equipment will have one of 4 colored notches in the upper left corner depending on the type (white = no affixes, blue = prefix or suffix, green = prefix and suffix, red = cursed)
- As before, the 'E' icon will be displayed if an item is equipped regardless of whether it's been identified or not

The idea of the notches is that the player can see quickly (especially in the shop) which items are 'good' and which are cursed.  Since this affects both the inventory and shop I'm going to debug it a bit more, but I'll build a new release in the next couple days that will also include a few other small changes.  Thanks for actually playing!
The changes have been released as v0.4.1.
